lines.zh: 我飘过石地，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I drift over the stone, silent.
My hem trails through the air.

lines.zh: 我穿过一堵墙，没有停下。
lines.en: I pass through a wall without stopping.
I float down the corridor slowly.

lines.zh: 我离地半尺，没有踩到任何东西。
lines.en: I hover half a foot up, touching nothing.
I move toward wherever the living are.
A faint light clings to me.

lines.zh: 我转过一个弯，走廊更暗。
lines.en: I round a corner, and the corridor darkens.
I drift and look from side to side.
I slip through the gap in the door.
I stop in midair and listen.
I drift slowly to the window.
I hang in the middle of the room, still.
I can't see my own hands.
It's cold here; I don't mind.
I don't remember anything.
I hear someone breathing.
This is how I've always drifted.
I try to recall the way I came.
There's a little white on me.
I'm so light the wind moves me.
I look at the wall for a while.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是想碰你一下。
lines.en: No malice — I only want to touch you once.
I'm right in front of you.
Are you cold too?
I want to touch you once.
I mean no harm, truly.
Don't put your hands up.
My voice sounds hollow.
It's very dark behind you.
I'm coming closer.
I haven't spoken to anyone in a long time.
A burst of white mist tears my chest.

lines.zh: 我又聚回来了，还是这个形状。
lines.en: I've re-formed. Same shape as before.
I feel no pain, only emptiness.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩进墙的另一边。
lines.en: The pain pulls me through to the wall's far side.
Struck nearly transparent.
I wavered.
I slowly take shape again.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我的轮廓晃了晃。
lines.en: Struck once — my outline wavers.
Half scattered — I gather myself back.

lines.zh: 被打得往后飘了半间屋。
lines.en: The blow drifted me half a room back.
I can't touch this one.
You remembered to save me some?

lines.zh: 那东西，我的手穿了过去。
lines.en: That thing — my hand passed right through.
I reach — and grasp only chill.
If it's for me, I'll keep it.
Set before me — I forgot hunger long ago.
Take it back.
Just let me look.
I can't quite recall that smell.
You eat it.
You walked right through the middle of me.
You shivered, didn't you?
You pass through me, so I give way.
I have no weight; nothing connects.

lines.zh: 你的手从我身上滑过去。
lines.en: Your hand slid through me.
That chill came with me.

lines.zh: 你的肩从我胸口穿了过去。
lines.en: Your shoulder passed through my chest.
I try not to come too near.
You stepped back — that's better.
I drift aside.
I'm the only one in this house.
There used to be another.
She drifted like this too.
We passed through the same wall.
Then she was gone.
I can't find her.
I'm still looking for her, always.
Have you seen her?
She wore something pale.
Never mind; I'll keep drifting.

lines.zh: 手指一合，东西还在地上。
lines.en: My fingers close; the thing stays on the ground.
I can't grip anything solid.
It fell on the floor.
I carry it against my body.
It has turned very cold.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过它，只能推你脚边。
lines.en: My hand passes through it — I nudge it to your feet.
I tried three times.
This time it didn't fall.
I carried it a short way.
It's too heavy; I set it down.
You've come too far inside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，脸对着你的脸。
lines.en: I turn slowly, my face to yours.

lines.zh: 你身上的暖气我找到了。
lines.en: I've found the warmth on you.
This room has no way out.
I'm coming through the wall.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把雾吹散了一线。
lines.en: Your breath parts the mist a little.
I'll come a little closer.
I'm drifting toward you.
Don't back into the corner.
Now you're here.
My hand floats in front of you.

lines.zh: 你的热气，我记在骨头里。
lines.en: Your warmth is etched into my bones.
One foot further.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方起了白雾。
lines.en: A white mist rises where I pass.
I've reached the space behind you.
I haven't been this close to anyone in ages.
Don't move; my touch is cold.
I come through the wall.

lines.zh: 我脚下是空的，什么都没有。
lines.en: My feet are on nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我的声音到不了你那儿。
lines.en: My voice doesn't reach you.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，半步都没离。
lines.en: I'm at your back, not half a step away.
I drift in, then back off half a step.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count each white breath you exhale.
This room keeps getting colder.
I come around the other side.
You turn, and I'm where I was.
You're going deeper in.
I needn't run — drifting is enough.
I passed through that table.

lines.zh: 飘着的我，看得见影子抖。
lines.en: Floating here, I see your shadow shake.

lines.zh: 我的冷气吹到了你耳后。
lines.en: My cold breath is at your ear.
My body is half transparent.
There's nothing behind you.
I float without feet.

lines.zh: 再走一步，我的冷就贴上你。
lines.en: One more step and my cold will touch you.
Through this wall and I'm upon you.

lines.zh: 我不害人，只想借你的暖气。
lines.en: I mean no harm — I just want your warmth.
I touched you once.
A chill spreads over you.

lines.zh: 我的手从你胸口穿过去。
lines.en: My hand passes through your chest.
A ghost's hand passed through you.
You should feel the cold now.

lines.zh: 我把冷意按进你的后颈。
lines.en: I press my chill into the back of your neck.
You shuddered.

lines.zh: 我的指尖擦过你的脖子。
lines.en: My fingertips brushed your neck.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从你身上滑开。
lines.en: My claws slide off you.
I've drifted back.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了你，不费力。
lines.en: My hand passes through you effortlessly.
There's a white mark on your arm.
Your breathing has quickened.
I scatter at a touch, then re-form, pulling back.
I'm in the air behind you.

lines.zh: 只是从我指尖漏出的一阵冷。
lines.en: Just a breath of cold leaking from my fingertips.
I seep through the wall.

lines.zh: 屋子里的温度低了一度。
lines.en: The room has dropped a degree.

lines.zh: 先飘一圈，认认这是谁家。
lines.en: I drift a circle, learning whose house this is.
My outline is very faint.

lines.zh: 我记不起墓碑上刻着什么。
lines.en: I can't recall what's carved on my stone.
I float up out of grave soil.
There's a lamp far off.
I drift toward it.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，已飘在别人的屋里。
lines.en: I opened my eyes already drifting in someone's house.
The quiet here suits me.
I trail a little white light.
I begin circling the room.
My feet hover half a block up.
I hang in the air, feet never touching ground.
The firelight nearly dissolves me.
I fall and scatter into white.
Water passes through me and I fade.
The blast blows me apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞里透出冷气。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, cold air hissing from the hole.
That force presses me to the wall.
I pass through walls without a sound.
The flash nearly wipes me out.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我却还在飘。
lines.en: There's nothing here, and I keep drifting.
